name: primitives-headless-disclosure

frames.best_why: All three answers are open and readable with the cursor off the card, so the whole list can be judged.

tagline: FAQ rows slide open to reveal a paragraph of answer text.
summary: Three bordered question rows with chevrons; clicking a row expands it to show a short answer, sliding the height open and fading the text in.
appearance: Three stacked rows on black, each a thin grey-bordered rounded rectangle with a bold question on the left and a small chevron on the right. An expanded row adds a grey answer paragraph beneath its question.
behaviour: Clicking a question opens its panel: the height animates from zero to fit while the text rises and fades in through a soft mask. Several rows can stay open at once, and the chevron flips.
demo_content: FAQ questions about headless UI, animation and accessibility, with answers that mention Framer Motion.
search_phrases: faq rows that expand on click
click a heading to reveal content
use_when: A FAQ or help section needs several question rows that expand and can stay open together.
avoid_when: It is renderless, so borders, padding, chevron and typography all need your own styling.
customise: Compose the question button and panel with your own content, and set transition, keepRendered and unmount; the height and mask animation is fixed.
weight_why: Three rows whose panels animate height and mask; idle when closed.

a11y.note: The demo removes the focus outline without adding a ring, so keyboard focus on the question rows is invisible.

issues: Answer text is small grey on near-black, which is hard to read.
Row borders are very faint, so collapsed rows blend into the stage.
polish_why: Tidy rows and a smooth masked reveal; faint borders and small grey answers are the weak points.
